The pharmaceutical business consists of research, development, manufacturing and sales of new prescription drugs, and these functional activities are managed on an integrated basis as a single business. The growth strategy 'TOP I 2030' identifies five areas of reform: drug discovery, development, pharmaceutical manufacturing, Value Delivery and growth foundations, and the company is pursuing medium molecules as a third modality following antibodies and small molecules.

entries.9c5ff28c468abe6b: The corporate group consists of the company, 15 subsidiaries and two subsidiaries of the parent company. As of December 31, 2025, ROCHE HOLDING LTD holds 61.10% of the total number of issued shares (excluding treasury shares) and is a major shareholder. The filing states that the alliance basic agreement, concluded in December 2001 and partially revised in July 2022, contemplates that Roche will acquire a majority, while the company will continue to independently conduct research, development, manufacturing and sales activities as a listed company.

Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥246.5 billion (down 0.5% year on year). The securities report explains that revenue from Avastin declined due to the penetration of generic drugs and drug price revisions, and revenue from Perjeta fell significantly, mainly because it is being replaced by Fesgo.
